name: Musume Seikatsu.
source:
What kind of game is this?
In a word, it's a game in which you can have the experience of living with your daughter.

Enjoy talking to her daily, gift her clothes and underwear (You can change the clothes she is wearing), have a warm life with your daughter. While you increase your intimacy with her, the "Touch" content will also increase.

Relax together in the living room and, sometimes, in the bathroom. You could even have a bath together.

Touch + animation in 50 scenes and more!

[Translated from Eos H Games]
translation:
这是什么游戏？
总之，这是一款可以体验和女儿一起生活的游戏。

每天享受与她的交谈，赠送她的衣服和内衣（你可以更换她穿的衣服），与你的女儿度过温馨的生活。当你和她的亲密度增加的同时，“触摸”的内容也会增加。

在客厅里一起放松，有时也在浴室里。你们甚至可以一起洗澡。

50个及更多场景中的触摸 + 动画！

【译自Eos H Games】
